title: STILL PRESENT (r2): queued-row take-over is a dead end — the menu offers 'Take over manually' but row_detail's Queued arm never renders the §7.7 confirm, so the action cannot complete
location: client/src/components/reference_panel.gleam:489-497 (overflow_actions Queued arm) vs 599-613 (row_detail Queued arm); view_take_over_confirm rendered only at 625-631 (Unreachable) and 661-667 (ContactInitiated)
evidence: overflow_actions: 'Queued -> list.append([RefcheckStart, RefcheckSkip], case call.hooks.can_take_over { True -> [RefcheckTakeOver] False -> [] })'; row_detail Queued arm: 'case pending_confirm(call.reference_call_id, RefcheckConfirmStart, confirm) { True -> view_start_confirm(call, app, slot, inflight) False -> element.none() }'; UserChoseRefcheckAction(RefcheckTakeOver) sets 'refcheck_confirm: Some(model.RefcheckConfirm(call_id: call_id, kind: RefcheckConfirmTakeOver))'
detail: W6 fix added the menu entry (hook can_take_over is True for queued rows), but choosing it sets an invisible confirm: the Queued arm only checks RefcheckConfirmStart, so no confirm ever renders and take-over can never be confirmed from a queued row. No test covers it.
recommended_fix: Render the take-over confirm in the Queued arm too (pending_confirm RefcheckConfirmTakeOver -> view_take_over_confirm), and pin a queued-row take-over test mirroring take_over_confirm_renders_inline_test.

title: STILL PRESENT (r2): the live-slot ON CONFLICT predicate is not single-sourced as claimed — insert_reference_call_skipped.sql still duplicates it
evidence: insert_reference_call_skipped.sql: 'ON CONFLICT (application_id, ref_slot, owner_label) WHERE status NOT IN ( \'form_completed\', \'unreachable\', \'refused\', \'objected\', \'manual_recorded\', \'failed\', \'completed\', \'partial\' ) DO NOTHING' — byte-identical to insert_reference_call_if_absent.sql:28-35; substitute_reference_call.sql is deleted and do_substitute calls sql.insert_reference_call_if_absent (that leg is fixed)
detail: The substitution leg is fixed (shared insert reused, predicate count 3->2), but the claimed 'predicate in ONE place' is not achieved: the skipped-insert path still carries the same drift-prone predicate, mirrored by the migration's partial index.
recommended_fix: Either accept the duplication as structural (document it) or parameterise the shared insert with status so insert_reference_call_skipped.sql calls it and the predicate lives in exactly one query.
